issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the |Y> resource preparation function: the problem statement and task description specify a function named `_make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float) -> None` (problem_statement.md), whereas both the template and the reference solution define and use `make_y_state(circ: stim.Circuit, q: int, p: float)` (no leading underscore). This mismatch between the documented API and the provided code can confuse students about which identifier to implement or call and may cause automated tests or graders (which expect the name used in the template) to fail.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fixes (pick one):
1) Update problem_statement.md to reference make_y_state(circ, q, p) (remove the leading underscore) so it matches the template and solution and any existing tests. OR
2) If the pedagogical intent is to mark the helper as 'private' with a leading underscore, rename the function in the template and solution from make_y_state to _make_y_state and update tests and all call sites accordingly. Also update any task descriptions/tests that assert the function name. Ensure the chosen name is documented in the task header and the tests use the same identifier.
